_description: Inputs for aggregate_overlap_fix.py: the VDIA/VBR block-band overlap correction and the VBR+VDIA+CSR extraction-order ablation.

_fields.prefix_vdia_segment_times_ns: per-segment VDIA times measured at commit c80e08d, the code that produced published_totals (the MKL DIA kernels changed in e92a8b3/d205961 afterwards, so later measurements are not in these units)
_fields.block_nnz_analysis: per-block full-matrix and post-band nnz, and block/band overlap flags
_fields.published_totals: the pre-correction VDIA+VBR+CSR results, kept so the reconstruction stays idempotent after the live files are overwritten
